mission_06: Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) is a supervised dimensionality reduction technique that finds linear combinations of features that best separate classes. Unlike PCA which is unsupervised and maximizes variance, LDA uses class labels to maximize between-class variance while minimizing within-class variance. The maximum number of LDA components is n_classes - 1. In this mission, you will apply LDA to a 4-class dataset, analyze the discriminant components, and understand how supervised dimensionality reduction differs from unsupervised methods like PCA.
